upgrade.tooltip.body: Install this on a {size} from the Hull Upgrades panel: open Hull Items in the ship's refit screen, then click this Hull Upgrade to install it. Installing a hull upgrade will consume it permanently.
upgrade.tooltip.disabled: Hull Upgrades are switched off in LunaLib settings. Switch them back on to install this.
upgrade.tooltip.storage: Opening Hull Item Storage or the Hull Upgrades panel moves this from your cargo into storage.
framework.panel.title: Hull Upgrades
framework.confirm.title: Install a {name}?
framework.confirm.body: Hull Upgrades are unique. This one will be used up, leaving {left} in storage, and this ship will hold {points} of {max} Hull Upgrade points. The point stays with this ship.
framework.panel.hint: Install a Hull Upgrade to gain a Hull Upgrade point, then spend points to unlock sections of the ship. A ship can hold up to {max} points, and locking a section again returns its point.
framework.panel.upgradeReady: Click the upgrade to install one. It is used up and grants this ship a Hull Upgrade point.
framework.panel.upgradeAtMax: This ship already has the maximum of {max} Hull Upgrade points.
framework.panel.upgradeNone: You have no {size} Hull Upgrades. They drop from salvage, Tech Mining and enemy flagships once you reach level {level}.
framework.socketHint.unlocked: Click to lock this section again. Its point is returned and any hull item in it goes back to storage.
framework.socketHint.available: Click to spend a Hull Upgrade point on this section.
framework.socketHint.restricted: This ship cannot use this section with its current fit.
framework.socketHint.noPoints: Install a Hull Upgrade to gain a point for this section.
framework.socketDescription.bridge: Holds bridge officers who improve combat readiness, weapon handling and how hard the ship hits each hull size.
framework.socketDescription.crew_quarter: Holds specialist crews for crew capacity, upkeep, repairs, sensors, electronic warfare and salvage.
framework.socketDescription.engine_room: Holds drive assemblies for speed, maneuverability, burn level and fuel economy.
framework.socketDescription.reactor: Holds power regulators for venting, capacitors, EMP resistance and weapon flux costs.
framework.socketDescription.armor_platin: Holds bolt-on plating for armor, hull and damage resistance.
framework.socketDescription.weapon_mount: Holds fire control for weapon damage, range, ammunition and point defence.
framework.socketDescription.shield_gener: Holds shield emitters for shield efficiency, upkeep, arc and response.
framework.socketDescription.phase_coil: Holds phase coils for cloak cost, phase speed and stealth.
framework.socketDescription.flight_deck: Holds deck crews for fighter replacement, refit times and fighter performance.
framework.socket.removeHint: Right-click the section to return this hull item to storage, or click it to choose a different one.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFramework: Click the highlighted {type} section on the ship to install {name}. Esc cancels.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFrameworkLoc: This ship has no {type} section unlocked for {name}. Unlock it in Hull Upgrades first. Esc cancels.
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgrades.name: Hull Upgrades
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgrades.tool: When off, Hull Upgrades and every hull item except Subroutines stop dropping from battles, salvage and tech mining, and the refit screen's Hull Items button is hidden. Subroutines and the skill tree work as normal. Sections your ships already have unlocked stop working but are kept, and switching this back on restores them.
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgradesLevel: The player level at which Hull Upgrades and hull items start dropping. Default 15.
settings.socketStorage.battleItems.name: Hull Item Drops From Battles
settings.socketStorage.battleItems.toolt: Scales how many hull items and Hull Upgrades drop after won battles. 100 is normal, 200 doubles them and 0 turns them off. They start dropping at the Hull Upgrades player level.
